0022600187.text: The Phoenix Suns host the Orlando Magic with the Suns at 1-4, 3rd in the Pacific and 12th in the West, and they have lost three straight, going 1-1 at home and 0-3 on the road. The Magic are 2-5, 5th in the Southeast and 12th in the East, with a two-game losing streak, a 0-4 home record and a 2-1 road record, and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain) are all out. For the Suns, Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) are unavailable, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the most recent meeting on March 31 in Orlando, a 115-111 Suns loss.
